text: Sharing my experience with teeth scaling. I had it done at the end of 2023, intending to use my social security benefits. I booked an appointment and came in for service, so I didn't have to pay upfront. When it was my turn, the dentist examined my teeth and assessed the cost. The dentist informed me that there was a lot of tartar and an additional charge of 300 baht. The dentist asked if I was comfortable with it, and I agreed. However, I was surprised because normally, the additional cost I pay every year is usually for polishing or flossing. This time, I felt a lot of jaw pain and difficulty breathing. The chair felt uncomfortable and tense in a way I'd never experienced before. After the scaling was finished, there was no polishing or flossing done.

text:
Personally, I was very disappointed with my experience on February 4th, 2024, at 4:30 PM, at the dentist on the first floor.
I took my girlfriend there for dental work, but we didn't proceed because...
1. The dentist said my girlfriend had a mouth full of tartar, even though she had just had a scaling done two weeks prior at another clinic. Isn't that confusing? She just had a scaling done, but her mouth is already full of tartar? 🤫
2. Two weeks prior, my girlfriend had four cavities, but she had just had two filled at the same clinic. However, the dentist here said all four had cavities and charged 1,000 baht for two and 1,500 baht for the other two...👏
I took my girlfriend and we walked out immediately.
(My personal opinion: Anyone who wants to get treatment here can go ahead. Thank you.)
